maddeler.e:
أشتعل (form VIII)
# أَشْتَعِلُ (ʔaštaʕilu) /ʔaʃ.ta.ʕi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# أُشْتَعَلُ (ʔuštaʕalu) /ʔuʃ.ta.ʕa.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# أَشْتَعِلَ (ʔaštaʕila) /ʔaʃ.ta.ʕi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# أُشْتَعَلَ (ʔuštaʕala) /ʔuʃ.ta.ʕa
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
